lean.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace ℝ G] [FiniteDimensional ℝ G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (A : E →L[ℝ] G) (B : F →L[ℝ] G), (∀ t : G, ‖A.adjoint t‖ ^ 2 + ‖B.adjoint t‖ ^ 2 = ‖t‖ ^ 2) → ((stdGaussian E).prod (stdGaussian F)).map (fun p => A p.1 + B p.2) = stdGaussian G
approved_definition_context: stdGaussian H is Mathlib's actual standard Gaussian probability measure with covariance identity on the finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space H. Measure.prod is the product measure; Measure.map is measurable pushforward; .adjoint is the inner-product adjoint of a continuous linear map.
